risks.risk: Wrong fitment (model/year/side LH vs RH) for the buyer’s car; headlamps vary by vehicle and region.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the headlamp back/mounting side showing part number/OEM code and the connector/fitment, plus a photo showing LH/RH marking.

risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of any OEM markings/engraving and the full part number sticker/label (back of lamp).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven genuine (treated like a standard used/possibly aftermarket headlamp).

risks.risk: Missing mounting clips/brackets or damaged internal mounts not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing all mounting points/clips/brackets from multiple angles (front and back).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed complete (assume missing/needs repair).

risks.risk: Lens condition may hide hairline cracks, moisture ingress, or reflector damage not visible in this single shot.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up of the lens edges and reflector surface, and a short video showing the lamp from different angles (and ideally a test with bulb/ignition).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with condition not fully verified.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the headlamp back showing the full part number/OEM code (sticker/engraving).
Confirm LH or RH with a photo showing the mounting side/markings.
Send photos of all mounting clips/brackets from the back (multiple angles).
Send a close-up of lens edges and reflector surface; if possible, a short video test with the bulb/indicator on.
